CAPABILITY suite for the Kafka stream source against a REDPANDA domain, via `--suite kafka/kafka`. Functions in functions/caps_kafka.py. Kafka is SOURCE-ONLY (the connector registers a stream source, no destination). The domain supplies the broker list (meta KAFKA_BROKERS) AND the data: a redpanda domain is a Kafka topic namespace whose data plane produces a model's rows as JSON, ONE MESSAGE PER ROW, to `.` (one topic per entity, one partition each, created by create-model). With the `employees` model at xs, `create-domains` seeds .employees (100 messages), .departments (9) and the derived .dept_emp/.dept_manager/.titles/.salaries (not consumed). PER-RUN TOPIC PREFIX: `` is the domain's in-system name, which tdx-xp derives per run (`xp___redpanda`); `KafkaStreamSrc.topic` is fixed when the function is written, so caps_kafka.py writes it as the `${D0__DB}` reference tdx-xp interpolates at registration (same for the templates' consumer groups) rather than pinning the domain's `name_in_system`. So CONCURRENT INSTANCES of this suite are fine — each gets its own topics, consumer groups and dead-letter topic. Append more messages with `tdx-domain modify-data --domain _redpanda --entity employees --ops Insert --sets 20` (redpanda is insert-only for modify-data — a Kafka log only appends — and REJECTS other ops). VARIANTS, one collection each: kafka_in (.employees, tabsdata.kafka.trigger.max_rows=25 -> the 100 seeded messages arrive at once and are staged together once the 60-second manifest floor passes), kafka_in_dlq (.departments, 9 messages, row trigger 5, all 9 staged together once the floor passes, plus a dlq_topic — the seeded messages all validate, so produce a violating line by hand to see .dead), kafka_in_time (.employees again with tabsdata.kafka.trigger.max_secs marked down to 15 seconds via unsafe_seconds(15), for tests only — own consumer group, so it sees every message too). ONE COLLECTION PER VARIANT with its OWN template (kafka_topic_in.yaml / _dlq / _time) because each stream joins its connection's consumer group and these topics have a single partition, so two consumers in one group would leave one idle. NO TRIGGERS, and none are needed: REGISTERING a stream publisher STARTS it — the worker comes up seconds after `create-project` and runs until `tdk fn disable`/`fn delete` (no execution plan or transaction; find it with `tdk worker list`). The consumer forces auto.offset.reset=earliest and commits its offsets only once a batch is staged, so worker-before-seed and seed-before-worker both work and a re-run resumes from the last staged position. So: `tdd xp one-shot --suite kafka/kafka --keep`, then watch `tdk trx list --proj

--monitor`. NOTE the broker address is the domain's host:port — reachable from a local instance, but a pod would need a routable address instead of localhost.
